scope: All material added by the user-post P21, its seal skirt, both matched P22 receivers and the angled mounts, plus every fastener, against the actual frozen Monolith/Bambu scene. Unchanged material inherits the previous qualification; removals cannot create a collision. This is not a new certification of the original rack, rail reach, or firmware limits.

paths.label: Own Bambu tool and dock: carriage withdrawal
paths.method: Exact BREP face distances, adaptively refined. Distance is 1-Lipschitz under translation: the smaller endpoint distance minus half the interval length bounds every point in it. Capped readings are conservative lower bounds, not reported exact distances.
